title: Introducing Peptides+: Supporting Peak Performance For Men, From the Inside Out
summary: Starting today, eligible men can access Peptides+, a new clinically guided specialty built around supporting goals for energy, recovery, and healthy aging.
body_markdown:
Many of the men I work with take their health seriously. They’ve built good routines and track their sleep, nutrition, and training, and their goal is to stay sharp and strong in the gym and everywhere else. It’s no surprise that many are looking for their next breakthrough, and peptides have gone from group chat chatter, to serious topics for patients and clinicians.


For many men exploring peptides, peak performance means getting the most out of both their body and mind. In a recent survey commissioned by Hims & Hers of 2,000 adults in the U.S., including 1,000 men, nearly half of the men (49%) said they’d want a peptide offering to support strength, and 37% said they’d hope a peptide could give them more energy. The goal isn’t just physical. Two-thirds of those surveyed said staying mentally sharp matters more to them than staying physically fit.¹ For performance-focused individuals who want the best of both, peptides can offer a way to support the body and brain at a cellular level.


Too often, getting them has meant relying on unreliable and unregulated online sellers, with little way to know what you’re getting. That changes today. Hims is launching[Peptides+](https://www.hims.com/peptides-plus) , a clinically-guided specialty that offers eligible men access to five treatments to start, built around their individual biology.


{inline-gallery}


Peptides are short chains of amino acids that cells use to send signals to one another. The Peptides+ specialty includes peptides and other well-known compounds the body relies on to provide support for cellular energy and repair. The compounded treatments in Peptides+ contain the below active ingredients:


- **Sermorelin** is a peptide that supports the body’s own growth hormone signaling, which matters for muscle, metabolism, and recovery.
- **Glutathione** is a naturally occurring antioxidant that supports the body’s cellular defenses against oxidative stress.
- **Vitamin B12** supports energy production, red blood cell formation, and brain and nervous system health. Low levels can cause fatigue, weakness, and brain fog in people who are deficient.
- **NAD+** is a coenzyme that helps cells produce energy and repair DNA. Natural levels tend to decline with age.
- **L-carnitine** is made from amino acids and supports cellular energy function and how the body uses fat for fuel.


A customer’s experience starts with an intake covering his health history, current medications and goals. An independent, licensed provider trained in peptide therapies then decides whether he’s eligible and which treatment, if any, makes sense for him. Treatments are compounded in the U.S. and dispensed by U.S. licensed pharmacies.


Peptides+ is available with Care+, which pairs treatment with a comprehensive insights and support experience. Customers have access to lab testing twice a year to track their progress, unlimited support and ongoing check-ins from a dedicated Care Team, and the option to message providers trained in peptide therapy 24/7 with any questions. To give customers and their providers a baseline from day one, without an office visit, the Hims[Men’s Core Panel](https://www.hims.com/testosterone/mens-core-panel) is an at-home blood collection kit for lab testing that provides insights across 22 biomarkers, including testosterone, vitamin D, and cholesterol. For those whose lab results indicate potential eligibility, Care+ customers can also connect with a provider to determine if a testosterone treatment may be right for them.


Proactive men are always looking for what’s next, and Peptides+ is built for them. Alongside sleep, training, nutrition, and regular check-ins with a provider, it’s another way to pursue what peak performance can be, both physically and cognitively. As curiosity about peptides grows, Hims & Hers is meeting it with clarity, and we’re excited to help shape the future of proactive health, with the clinical rigor that men deserve.


[Hims](https://www.hims.com/peptides-plus) & Hers plans to add more peptides and therapies to this specialty, and looks forward to offering BPC-157 and TB-500 consistent with regulatory standards.
